authority.serializedSnapshots: The ten promoted snapshots are owned committed evidence; the ignored APK extraction is not a verifier input.
authority.particleRandomBoundary: Serialized graph/modules/renderers/materials are original evidence. Deterministic random assignment and phase samples are an independent portable oracle, not a native random witness.
authority.visibleBoundary: The original device frame is independent framebuffer evidence. It may close a product visible gate only under the complete same-state tuple.

ordinaryParticles.targetMeaning: single-width normal, skill and flick judgement roots used by the reported B.B.K product scenario; range-width routing is separate and cannot close this gate

shapeAxis.coneType4: native helper 0x123C050 constructs local position in XY with Z=0 and direction in XY plus positive Z, then calls 0x1241914
shapeAxis.boxType5: dispatcher 0x12357F0 constructs centered XYZ components from three random lanes before 0x1241914
shapeAxis.circleType10: native helper 0x123F830 constructs local position and radial direction in XY with Z=0, then calls 0x1241914
shapeAxis.transform: 0x1241914 is the shape-to-particle transform handoff; portable position/velocity continue to consume the full serialized Transform parent chain

rendererConsumption.systemGraph: play the selected root and every authored child ParticleSystem; a root handle, one circle, nonzero count, or wide-note route alone fails
rendererConsumption.geometry: distinguish serialized billboard mode 0 from stretched billboard mode 1; consume alignment, pivot, min/max particle size, velocity scale and length scale from each renderer
rendererConsumption.localScaling: simulation position/velocity consume system plus full parent chain; billboard size in Local scaling mode consumes the emitting ParticleSystem local scale exactly once
rendererConsumption.texture: consume the material's complete top-left decoded atlas and select per-particle UV tiles; atlas pixel dimensions are not world geometry
rendererConsumption.blend: all enabled focused renderers use additive materials; straight-alpha texture RGB must not be multiplied by particle alpha a second time
rendererConsumption.publication: publish one immutable sample after simulation per host outer frame; expired particles are absent from that frame

originalRendererPrimary: Unity renderer queue/distance using renderer bounds
sortingResolution.serializedSortMode: all focused renderers use ParticleSystemRenderer m_SortMode=0; do not invent per-particle distance sorting
sortingResolution.portableTupleClassification: product deterministic tie-break only, not original renderer-bounds evidence
sortingResolution.supersededConflict: The predecessor negative-renderer-bounds-center-z tuple remains a renderer approximation and must not be filled with particle.position.z. It is not the focused portable tuple.
sortingResolution.whyPortableTieBreakIsAllowed: focused enabled materials are additive; exact equal-order GPU quantization remains open and is not reclassified

captureAttribution.captureMechanism: adb exec-out screencap is invoked synchronously while the already-drained event batch is iterated; it is not an atomic GPU frame hook
captureAttribution.meaning: the committed pixels prove a complete original ordinary judgement composition, but do not isolate one root, one lane, native random draws, or one exact post-trigger phase

featureGate.largeGlowRequired: both judgement-glow regions must retain multiple connected bright components over area 160 after the judgement-line exclusion
featureGate.fineClusterRequired: both star-and-glow regions must retain at least 40 white connected components with area 2..160
featureGate.simultaneousRequirement: large glow and fine star/spark cluster are one gate; satisfying only one side fails

requiredProductionGates: same-tuple framebuffer large-glow plus fine-star feature gate
